rubric.role_summary: Project Manager overseeing schedules, budgets, and delivery of concurrent energy project deployments from sales through commercial operation, while improving project-management processes.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Project Manager overseeing schedules, budgets, and delivery of concurrent energy project deployments from sales through commercial operation, while improving project-management processes.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience managing and delivering complex projects.
- Background in commercial energy, infrastructure, or construction.
- Ownership of technical and/or construction-related scopes in electrical construction, general construction, EV charging infrastructure, energy generation, data centers, or similarly regulated physical work.
- Experience creating and managing project schedules.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Prior use of construction or PM tracking software, such as Procore, Smartsheet, Sitetracker, or Buildertrend.
- Direct experience with C&I solar, BESS, EV charging, or utility interconnection.
- PMP, CAPM, or equivalent.
- Experience in a startup without implemented PM software or procedures.
- Experience delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
- Experience tracking budget and schedule variance in a spreadsheet or PM tool and translating it into customer or leadership updates.
- Ability to read electrical single-line diagrams and use them in field constructability discussions.
- Experience creating and managing Gantt-style schedules with dependency logic and adapting plans when field conditions change.
- Experience working in a lean team, such as a startup, small company, or sole proprietorship.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Los Angeles area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
